en: Attune is AI and can make mistakes. Check important info.
t: Attune ni AI na inaweza kukosea. Hakiki taarifa muhimu.

en: Assistants are experts you set up once — their instructions are used in every chat you start with them.
t: Wasaidizi ni wataalamu unaowaweka mara moja — maelekezo yao hutumika katika kila gumzo unaloanza nao.

en: Mobile & tower cranes: lifts, load charts, hydraulics, safety
t: Kreni za simu na za mnara: kunyanyua, chati za mzigo, haidroliki, usalama

en: From beginner to native-like, with corrections
t: Kutoka mwanzo hadi kama mzawa, pamoja na masahihisho

en: Complete, good-looking sites and tools from one prompt
t: Tovuti na zana kamili na nzuri kutoka ombi moja

en: Invoices, VAT, zakat, statements — worked out exactly
t: Ankara, VAT, zaka, taarifa za fedha — zimekokotolewa sawasawa

en: Emails, reports and posts in English or Arabic
t: Barua pepe, ripoti na machapisho kwa Kiingereza au Kiarabu

en: A project keeps related chats together with shared instructions and your own files — like a folder the assistant has read.
t: Mradi huweka pamoja mazungumzo yanayohusiana pamoja na maelekezo ya pamoja na faili zako — kama folda ambayo msaidizi ameisoma.

en: Instant does one quick job on any text or photo — answer it, rewrite it, translate it, summarise it — without starting a chat. For a conversation use Chat; for places near you, Instant hands you to the map.
t: Papo Hapo hufanya kazi moja ya haraka kwenye maandishi au picha yoyote — kuijibu, kuiandika upya, kuitafsiri, kuifupisha — bila kuanza gumzo. Kwa mazungumzo tumia Gumzo; kwa maeneo karibu nawe, Papo Hapo hukupeleka kwenye ramani.

en:
Type what you want, or paste anything.

“Summarise this in Arabic: …”  ·  “لخصلي الرسالة دي”
“I got my period 2 hours ago, it was heavy”
t:
Andika unachotaka, au bandika chochote.

“Fupisha hii kwa Kiarabu: …”  ·  “لخصلي الرسالة دي”
“Hedhi yangu imeanza saa 2 zilizopita, ni nzito”

en: Paste text or add a photo on the left, pick a job, and the result shows here.
t: Bandika maandishi au ongeza picha upande wa kushoto, chagua kazi, na matokeo yataonekana hapa.

en: Runs on your phone · works with no signal
t: Inafanya kazi kwenye simu yako · bila mtandao

en: Who owes whom, what was promised, which dates were agreed and which questions got no answer — read from a WhatsApp chat on your phone. The chat never leaves the phone.
t: Nani anadaiwa na nani, nini kiliahidiwa, tarehe gani zilikubaliwa na maswali gani hayakujibiwa — kusomwa kutoka gumzo la WhatsApp kwenye simu yako. Gumzo haliondoki kwenye simu.

en: In WhatsApp, open the chat → ⋮ → More → Export chat → Without media.
t: Katika WhatsApp, fungua gumzo → ⋮ → Zaidi → Hamisha gumzo → Bila media.

en: Pick Attune in the share list — or save the file and choose it here.
t: Chagua Attune kwenye orodha ya kushiriki — au hifadhi faili na uichague hapa.

en: Who owes whom, promises and dates, unanswered questions — and you can ask the chat anything.
t: Nani anadaiwa na nani, ahadi na tarehe, maswali yasiyojibiwa — na unaweza kuuliza gumzo lolote.

en: Ask about your money, health, people, meals or deadlines…
t: Uliza kuhusu pesa, afya, watu, milo au tarehe za mwisho…

en: Answered from your own records on this device, by code — nothing is sent anywhere, and every number can be checked in the tool it came from.
t: Imejibiwa kutoka kumbukumbu zako kwenye kifaa hiki, kwa msimbo — hakuna kinachotumwa popote, na kila namba inaweza kuhakikiwa kwenye zana ilikotoka.

en: One question, answered from everything Attune keeps for you — money, debts, medicines, lab results, meals, deadlines and notes.
t: Swali moja, linajibiwa kutoka kila kitu Attune inakuhifadhia — pesa, madeni, dawa, vipimo vya maabara, milo, tarehe za mwisho na madokezo.

en: Finds money in your own payments — on this phone, by code. It only counts what you did.
t: Hupata pesa katika malipo yako mwenyewe — kwenye simu hii, kwa msimbo. Huhesabu tu ulichofanya.

en: Nothing to fix right now. The Guardian looks again every time a payment comes in.
t: Hakuna cha kurekebisha sasa hivi. Mlinzi huangalia tena kila malipo yanapoingia.

en: Each time you note a price, it says how it compares with last time — per kilo or litre when you give the size.
t: Kila unapoandika bei, inakuambia jinsi inavyolinganishwa na mara iliyopita — kwa kilo au lita ukitaja ukubwa.

en: Free trials, renewals, returns, warranties and documents — Attune warns you before each one. Everything stays on this phone.
t: Majaribio ya bure, usasishaji, kurudisha bidhaa, dhamana na nyaraka — Attune inakuonya kabla ya kila kimoja. Kila kitu kinabaki kwenye simu hii.

en: Nothing to watch yet. Scan a receipt, paste a trial email, or add a passport or warranty by hand.
t: Bado hakuna cha kufuatilia. Skani risiti, bandika barua pepe ya jaribio, au ongeza pasipoti au dhamana kwa mkono.

en: Debts, installments, savings circles, bills — with a checkbox for every payment.
t: Madeni, malipo kwa awamu, vikundi vya kuweka akiba, bili — na kisanduku cha tiki kwa kila malipo.

en: Type it as you'd say it — “Ahmed owes me 12,000, 1,000 a month for a year”
t: Iandike kama unavyoisema — “Ahmed ananidai 12,000, 1,000 kwa mwezi kwa mwaka mmoja”

en: Try: «جمعية ٢٠٠٠ في الشهر لمدة ١٠ شهور ودوري الرابع» or “Netflix 200 every month”.
t: Jaribu: «جمعية ٢٠٠٠ في الشهر لمدة ١٠ شهور ودوري الرابع» au “Netflix 200 kila mwezi”.

en: Your people and plans appear here
t: Watu na mipango yako vinaonekana hapa

en: Before you pay or sign: paste the offer, the seller's message or an installment plan — or add a screenshot. Attune works out the real cost, checks the market price, looks for scam signs and writes your reply.
t: Kabla ya kulipa au kusaini: bandika ofa, ujumbe wa muuzaji au mpango wa awamu — au ongeza picha ya skrini. Attune inakokotoa gharama halisi, inakagua bei ya soko, inatafuta dalili za utapeli na inaandika jibu lako.

en: e.g. “iPhone 15 Pro 256GB, like new, 38,000 EGP, deposit on Vodafone Cash to hold it”  ·  “12,400 EGP or 3 × 4,133 with valU”
t: mf. “iPhone 15 Pro 256GB, kama mpya, 38,000 EGP, weka amana kwa Vodafone Cash kuishikilia”  ·  “12,400 EGP au 3 × 4,133 kwa valU”

en: The real cost, the market price, scam signs and a reply to send.
t: Gharama halisi, bei ya soko, dalili za utapeli na jibu la kutuma.

en: e.g. a 3-bedroom flat for rent in Maadi under 15,000, not ground floor
t: mf. nyumba ya vyumba 3 ya kupanga Maadi chini ya 15,000, si ghorofa ya chini

en: Scout checks each goal when you open Attune (at most twice a day), once at night on the phone, and whenever you tap Check now, and tells you only about strong new finds or price drops. It reads public ads only and never contacts anyone or pays for you.
t: Scout hukagua kila lengo unapofungua Attune (si zaidi ya mara mbili kwa siku), mara moja usiku kwenye simu, na kila unapogusa Kagua sasa, na hukuambia tu kuhusu vitu vipya vizuri au bei zinaposhuka. Husoma matangazo ya umma tu na haiwasiliani na mtu yeyote wala kukulipia.

en: Say once what you're looking for — a flat, a car, a product, a job, a supplier. Scout searches the sites that matter, checks every wish against what each ad says, tells you if the price is fair, and lets you know when something good appears.
t: Sema mara moja unachotafuta — nyumba, gari, bidhaa, kazi, msambazaji. Scout hutafuta kwenye tovuti muhimu, hulinganisha kila hitaji na kile tangazo linasema, hukuambia kama bei ni ya haki, na hukujulisha kitu kizuri kinapotokea.

en: Just say it in Chat: “remind me tomorrow at 9 to call Ahmed”, “صحيني الساعة 6”, “ابعت لمحمود على الواتساب إني هتأخر”. You always confirm first.
t: Sema tu kwenye Gumzo: “nikumbushe kesho saa 9 nimpigie Ahmed”, “صحيني الساعة 6”, “ابعت لمحمود على الواتساب إني هتأخر”. Wewe huthibitisha kwanza kila mara.

en: What do you want to do today? “study 2 hours, gym 1h, call mum 15 min”
t: Unataka kufanya nini leo? “kusoma saa 2, gym saa 1, kumpigia mama dakika 15”

en: Medicines and reminders for the family, lab results over time
t: Dawa na vikumbusho kwa familia, vipimo vya maabara kwa muda

en: Set it up in a minute — then log a meal by typing, saying or a photo.
t: Iweke kwa dakika moja — kisha andika mlo kwa kuandika, kusema au picha.

en: Medicines, reminders and lab results for your family — read from the prescription and the report, kept on this phone. Not medical advice: ask your doctor or pharmacist.
t: Dawa, vikumbusho na vipimo vya maabara kwa familia yako — vinasomwa kutoka kwenye cheti cha daktari na ripoti, vinahifadhiwa kwenye simu hii. Si ushauri wa kitabibu: muulize daktari au mfamasia wako.

en: Tap a day below, or type it in Instant: “my period started yesterday, light”.
t: Gusa siku hapa chini, au iandike kwenye Papo Hapo: “hedhi yangu ilianza jana, nyepesi”.

en: Stays on this phone — kept out of Memory and never sent anywhere. Predictions are estimates, not contraception or medical advice.
t: Inabaki kwenye simu hii — haiwekwi kwenye Kumbukumbu na haitumwi popote. Utabiri ni makadirio, si njia ya uzazi wa mpango wala ushauri wa kitabibu.

en: A short lesson a day, cards that come back until you know them, and a quiz every few lessons.
t: Somo fupi kila siku, kadi zinazorudi hadi uzijue, na jaribio kila baada ya masomo machache.

en: Snap the homework — Attune teaches it step by step, with pictures and a voice. Maths is checked by code before you see it.
t: Piga picha ya kazi ya nyumbani — Attune inaifundisha hatua kwa hatua, kwa picha na sauti. Hesabu hukaguliwa kwa msimbo kabla hujaiona.

en: Type or snap the homework, then tap Teach me on a problem.
t: Andika au piga picha ya kazi ya nyumbani, kisha gusa Nifundishe kwenye swali.

en: The words your trade uses, that a general model gets wrong every time. Teach it once and it never gets them wrong again — in answers, documents and translations alike. This is the part of the app that gets better the longer you use it, and the part nobody can copy.
t: Maneno ya fani yako, ambayo modeli ya kawaida huyakosea kila mara. Ifundishe mara moja na haitayakosea tena — katika majibu, nyaraka na tafsiri vilevile. Hii ndiyo sehemu ya app inayozidi kuwa bora kadiri unavyoitumia, na sehemu ambayo hakuna anayeweza kuiiga.

en: or save the first box as a writing rule — “always state VAT separately”
t: au hifadhi kisanduku cha kwanza kama kanuni ya uandishi — “taja VAT kando kila mara”

en: Nothing yet. The fastest way to start: when an answer uses the wrong word, tap “a word is wrong” under it.
t: Bado hakuna kitu. Njia ya haraka ya kuanza: jibu likitumia neno lisilo sahihi, gusa “neno moja si sahihi” chini yake.

en: What it has learned from your corrections
a plain file — yours, readable, not locked in
t: faili la kawaida — lako, linasomeka, halijafungwa

en: Paste a message or write a site note, and anything you promised in it shows up here.
t: Bandika ujumbe au andika dokezo la eneo la kazi, na chochote ulichoahidi ndani yake kitaonekana hapa.

en: Read what's in Instant for promises
t: Soma ahadi zilizo kwenye Papo Hapo

en: Every item carries the exact words it came from. If those words aren't in what you wrote, it never gets here — the app can miss something, but it cannot make one up.
t: Kila kipengele kina maneno halisi kilikotoka. Kama maneno hayo hayamo katika ulichoandika, hakifiki hapa — app inaweza kukosa kitu, lakini haiwezi kubuni.

en: Search or ask — “wedding photos last month”, «لينكات الشقة»
t: Tafuta au uliza — “picha za harusi mwezi uliopita”, «لينكات الشقة»

en: Keep a note, a link or a photo above — or share anything to Attune from another app.
t: Hifadhi dokezo, kiungo au picha hapo juu — au shiriki chochote kwa Attune kutoka app nyingine.

en: Your shelf is empty. Tap + to make your first book.
t: Rafu yako iko tupu. Gusa + kutengeneza kitabu chako cha kwanza.

en: When you ask for a fact, Chat first looks it up in your sources and shows which one it used.
t: Ukiuliza ukweli fulani, Gumzo kwanza hulitafuta kwenye vyanzo vyako na huonyesha kilichotumika.

en: What you get: small models answer facts from your sources correctly (in our test, 31 → 99 of 104 for the smallest model). Looking up takes under a tenth of a second and nothing leaves the phone.
t: Unachopata: modeli ndogo hujibu ukweli kutoka vyanzo vyako kwa usahihi (katika jaribio letu, 31 → 99 kati ya 104 kwa modeli ndogo zaidi). Kutafuta huchukua chini ya sehemu ya kumi ya sekunde na hakuna kinachoondoka kwenye simu.

en: Text, Markdown, PDF or Word. In Ask a PDF, “Add to Knowledge” keeps the document you opened.
t: Maandishi, Markdown, PDF au Word. Katika Uliza PDF, “Ongeza kwenye Maarifa” huhifadhi hati uliyofungua.

en: Nothing here yet — paste a text or add a file.
t: Bado hakuna kitu hapa — bandika maandishi au ongeza faili.

en: Chat looks these up before it answers, and shows the source. They download by themselves when you are online and stay up to date.
t: Gumzo huvitafuta hivi kabla ya kujibu, na huonyesha chanzo. Hupakuliwa vyenyewe ukiwa mtandaoni na husasishwa.

en: Downloads work in the Android app.
t: Upakuaji unafanya kazi kwenye app ya Android.

en: Knowledge packs you make from your chats and files — the model reads them when it answers, like the public packs.
t: Vifurushi vya maarifa unavyotengeneza kutoka mazungumzo na faili zako — modeli huvisoma inapojibu, kama vifurushi vya umma.

en: No packs yet. Make one from your chats, notes or Markdown files.
t: Bado hakuna vifurushi. Tengeneza kimoja kutoka mazungumzo, madokezo au faili za Markdown.

en: Follow a team, a player, a market, a subject. Each day: what happened in the last 24 hours, with the sources.
t: Fuatilia timu, mchezaji, soko, somo. Kila siku: kilichotokea saa 24 zilizopita, pamoja na vyanzo.

en: Six pages. Open one — the tools inside it are tabs at its top.
t: Kurasa sita. Fungua moja — zana zilizomo ni vichupo juu yake.

en: Convert, translate, ask a PDF, slides & reports, CV, video downloads
t: Badilisha, tafsiri, uliza PDF, slaidi na ripoti, CV, kupakua video

en: Code, better prompts, compress, humanize, copilot, prompt library
t: Msimbo, maombi bora, kubana, kufanya kama binadamu, msaidizi, maktaba ya maombi

en: Offline maps, country packs and phrases
t: Ramani nje ya mtandao, vifurushi vya nchi na misemo

en: Crane toolkit, site reports, fleet and your business
t: Zana za kreni, ripoti za eneo la kazi, magari na biashara yako

en: How to use every tool, and what stays on your phone
t: Jinsi ya kutumia kila zana, na kinachobaki kwenye simu yako

en: PDF ↔ Word, PowerPoint → PDF, photos → PDF, scanned paper → editable Word, Excel ↔ CSV ↔ JSON, e-books, web pages, subtitles, merge and split PDFs — on your phone. Your files are never uploaded to a converter website.
t: PDF ↔ Word, PowerPoint → PDF, picha → PDF, karatasi iliyoskaniwa → Word inayoharirika, Excel ↔ CSV ↔ JSON, vitabu pepe, kurasa za wavuti, manukuu, kuunganisha na kugawanya PDF — kwenye simu yako. Faili zako hazipakiwi kamwe kwenye tovuti ya kubadilisha.

en: It shows what it can become
Any language, on this phone. Numbers, names and codes can't be changed; every part is checked, and anything doubtful is marked.
t: Lugha yoyote, kwenye simu hii. Namba, majina na misimbo haviwezi kubadilishwa; kila sehemu inakaguliwa, na chochote chenye shaka kinawekwa alama.

en: Every part is checked: numbers, names and codes kept exactly.
t: Kila sehemu inakaguliwa: namba, majina na misimbo vinabaki vilevile.

en: Open a PDF, Word file, book or web page. Read it here and chat with it — every answer shows the page it came from. Everything stays on your phone.
t: Fungua PDF, faili la Word, kitabu au ukurasa wa wavuti. Isome hapa na uzungumze nayo — kila jibu linaonyesha ukurasa lilikotoka. Kila kitu kinabaki kwenye simu yako.

en: Reading and searching work now. To chat with the file, install a model in Engine.
t: Kusoma na kutafuta vinafanya kazi sasa. Ili kuzungumza na faili, sakinisha modeli kwenye Injini.

en: Open a file: it is kept on this device, with its chat and notes, so you can come back to it.
t: Fungua faili: inahifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki, pamoja na gumzo na madokezo yake, ili uweze kuirudia.

en: Describe it in one sentence — the AI on your phone writes a designed PowerPoint or a full report, from the web or your own file. Edit any slide, then save it as PowerPoint, Word or PDF.
t: Ieleze kwa sentensi moja — AI kwenye simu yako huandika PowerPoint iliyopambwa au ripoti kamili, kutoka wavuti au faili lako. Hariri slaidi yoyote, kisha ihifadhi kama PowerPoint, Word au PDF.

en: e.g. A pitch for our café to offices in New Cairo: menu, catering, prices, why us
t: k.m. Wasilisho la mkahawa wetu kwa ofisi za New Cairo: menyu, huduma ya chakula, bei, kwa nini sisi

en: Research the web for facts and figures
t: Tafuta ukweli na takwimu kwenye wavuti

en: Each slide names its sources, and a Sources slide lists every page
t: Kila slaidi inataja vyanzo vyake, na slaidi ya Vyanzo inaorodhesha kila ukurasa

en: Base it on my file (Word, PDF, Excel, CSV…)
t: Itegemeze kwenye faili langu (Word, PDF, Excel, CSV…)

en: Each slide or section shows here as it is written.
t: Kila slaidi au sehemu inaonekana hapa inapoandikwa.

en: Build a CV in English or Arabic, keep a copy for every job, and export a clean PDF or Word file. The AI on your phone helps with wording.
t: Tengeneza CV kwa Kiingereza au Kiarabu, weka nakala kwa kila kazi, na hamisha PDF au faili la Word safi. AI kwenye simu yako inasaidia kwa maneno.

en: Start a new one, or import the one you already have.
t: Anza mpya, au leta uliyonayo tayari.

en: Copy a video's link, paste it here, pick the quality — it's saved to your phone's Movies folder. Works with direct video links, Google Drive, Dropbox, archive.org, Wikimedia Commons and pages that show a plain video.
t: Nakili kiungo cha video, kibandike hapa, chagua ubora — inahifadhiwa kwenye folda ya Movies ya simu yako. Inafanya kazi na viungo vya moja kwa moja vya video, Google Drive, Dropbox, archive.org, Wikimedia Commons na kurasa zinazoonyesha video ya kawaida.

en: Paste a link and tap Find the video — then pick the quality to download.
t: Bandika kiungo na ugusa Tafuta video — kisha chagua ubora wa kupakua.

en: No map on this device yet
t: Bado hakuna ramani kwenye kifaa hiki

en: Download the world map to see every country, or your country's map for streets, places and offline search.
t: Pakua ramani ya dunia kuona kila nchi, au ramani ya nchi yako kwa mitaa, maeneo na utafutaji nje ya mtandao.

en: Search a place and tap “Save” — saved places work with no signal.
t: Tafuta mahali na ugusa “Hifadhi” — maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa yanafanya kazi bila mtandao.

en: See what the airline owes you — up to €600 — and get the letter
t: Ona shirika la ndege linakudai nini — hadi €600 — na upate barua

en: Add where you fly from and the dates above.
t: Ongeza unakoruka kutoka na tarehe hapo juu.

en: Download once on Wi-Fi — everything then works on a plane, in a tunnel, or with roaming switched off.
t: Pakua mara moja kwenye Wi-Fi — kisha kila kitu kinafanya kazi ndani ya ndege, kwenye handaki, au roaming ikiwa imezimwa.

en: Studio draws pictures with the phone's own chip — it works in the Android app.
t: Studio huchora picha kwa chip ya simu yenyewe — inafanya kazi kwenye app ya Android.

en: Code that is tested before you get it
The model writes the program and its tests, the phone runs them, and any error goes straight back to the model to fix — until the tests pass. Offline, in a locked sandbox.
t: Modeli huandika programu na majaribio yake, simu huyaendesha, na kosa lolote hurudi moja kwa moja kwa modeli kulirekebisha — hadi majaribio yapite. Nje ya mtandao, ndani ya sanduku lililofungwa.

en: What should it do? e.g. “A function that splits a restaurant bill between friends, with the tip”
t: Ifanye nini? k.m. “Function inayogawanya bili ya mgahawa kati ya marafiki, pamoja na bakshishi”

en: The program and its tests appear here
t: Programu na majaribio yake yanaonekana hapa

en: Each step, the code, a live preview for web pages, and whether the tests passed.
t: Kila hatua, msimbo, onyesho la moja kwa moja kwa kurasa za wavuti, na kama majaribio yamepita.

en: e.g. i need you to like maybe compare laptops and stuff, the top ones, for uni
t: k.m. nataka uli-compare laptop na vitu kama hivyo, zile bora, kwa chuo

en: Any context the tool should know first
t: Muktadha wowote ambao zana inapaswa kujua kwanza

en: Adds an expert's framing for your field to the rewritten prompt — e.g. Heavy Equipment makes it ask for load capacities, safety factors and specs. Tap one, then use a starter below.
t: Huongeza mtazamo wa mtaalamu wa fani yako kwenye ombi lililoandikwa upya — mf. Mitambo Mizito huifanya iulize uwezo wa mzigo, vipimo vya usalama na sifa. Gusa kimoja, kisha tumia kianzio hapa chini.
= muundo wa papo hapo kwenye kifaa.

en: = the model rethinks and rephrases your prompt.
t: = modeli inafikiri upya na kuandika upya ombi lako.

en: Write a rough prompt, then hit
t: Andika ombi la awali, kisha gusa

en: to see the model rethink it — or Structure for an instant offline version.
t: kuona modeli ikilifikiria upya — au Muundo kwa toleo la papo hapo nje ya mtandao.

en: Paste a long, wordy prompt — AI Compress will think and shrink it.
t: Bandika ombi refu lenye maneno mengi — AI Compress itafikiri na kulifupisha.

en: Paste the earlier messages — anything already established gets dropped.
t: Bandika jumbe za awali — chochote kilichokwisha kuthibitishwa kinaondolewa.

en: Handles structure well; tags survive compression.
t: Inashughulikia muundo vizuri; lebo zinabaki baada ya kubana.

en: A quarter of the window is held back for the answer — a prompt that exactly fills the context leaves no room to reply.
t: Robo ya dirisha imehifadhiwa kwa ajili ya jibu — ombi linalojaza muktadha wote halibakishi nafasi ya kujibu.
= kuondoa maneno ya ziada papo hapo (nje ya mtandao).

en: = the model rewrites it far shorter while keeping the meaning.
t: = modeli huiandika upya fupi zaidi huku ikibaki na maana.

en: Paste a wordy prompt and hit
t: Bandika ombi lenye maneno mengi na ugusa

en: — it thinks about meaning, not just filler words.
t: — hufikiria maana, si maneno ya ziada tu.

en: Paste AI-generated or stiff text — it comes back sounding like a person wrote it.
t: Bandika maandishi ya AI au magumu — yanarudi yakisikika kama ameyaandika mtu.

en: (this is what makes it sound like you)
Paste a few paragraphs you wrote yourself — an email, a message, anything in your natural voice.
t: Bandika aya chache ulizoandika mwenyewe — barua pepe, ujumbe, chochote kwa sauti yako ya kawaida.

en: Keeps your meaning and facts exactly — changes only how it reads. The writing sample is optional but makes the biggest difference.

en: Nothing below 4-bit is offered. The quality loss there falls hardest on Arabic, which would make the app worse for the people most likely to use it.
t: Hakuna kinachotolewa chini ya 4-bit. Upotevu wa ubora hapo unaathiri zaidi Kiarabu, jambo ambalo lingeifanya app kuwa mbaya kwa watu wanaoweza kuitumia zaidi.

en: Flash mode on this phone: the model stays on storage and only the experts each word needs are read into memory — about 3–8 words a second, slower than the small models but far more knowledgeable. Needs {g} GB free storage.
t: Hali ya Flash kwenye simu hii: modeli inabaki kwenye hifadhi na wataalamu wanaohitajika kwa kila neno tu ndio husomwa kwenye kumbukumbu — takriban maneno 3–8 kwa sekunde, polepole kuliko modeli ndogo lakini yenye maarifa mengi zaidi. Inahitaji {g} GB za hifadhi ya bure.

en: Google Takeout → Deselect all → Mail → Export. Open the .mbox file here. Attune reads only emails about money from the last 12 months, and keeps a link to each one.
t: Google Takeout → Deselect all → Mail → Export. Fungua faili la .mbox hapa. Attune inasoma tu barua pepe zinazohusu pesa za miezi 12 iliyopita, na inaweka kiungo cha kila moja.

en: Each cloud answer is a worked example. Collected, they train the small adapters that bring on-device quality up to cloud level — and a slice is held back to prove it. Stored on this device only.
t: Kila jibu la wingu ni mfano uliofanyiwa kazi. Yakikusanywa, hufunza adapta ndogo zinazoleta ubora wa kwenye kifaa hadi kiwango cha wingu — na sehemu huwekwa kando kuthibitisha hilo. Huhifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki tu.

en: which leaves plenty of room for long conversations
t: ambayo inaacha nafasi kubwa kwa mazungumzo marefu

en: Core Max, Sense, Zenith, Apex and Everest run on a computer: get them in the Attune desktop app.
t: Core Max, Sense, Zenith, Apex na Everest zinafanya kazi kwenye kompyuta: zipate kwenye app ya Attune ya kompyuta.

en: Too heavy for a phone — it can close the app. Core or Blaze run smoothly here; this one is in the desktop app.
t: Nzito mno kwa simu — inaweza kufunga app. Core au Blaze zinafanya kazi vizuri hapa; hii iko kwenye app ya kompyuta.
